race.verdict: HOURMAN looked an improved model when making an impressive winning reappearance at Hexham and with this return to a longer trip also a plus he gets a confident vote. Moon Over America returns from a year's absence but remains with potential and could emerge as the chief threat ahead of Pure Gold and last year's victor Heart Above . HOURMAN (FR) MOON OVER AMERICA (IRE) PURE GOLD
